_what: C-9 (c): THE FIRE BALL'S FIDELITY PROOF -- the kit's own runtime (cliffside's renderer, Compatibility on ANGLE Metal) against the baked flipbook played over the same painted Barrow ground (a 1600x900 crop of the painting at 1:1), same frames, same camera, texel by texel (godot/tools/proof_fire_bolt.gd). mean |d| over the effect's footprint: texels where either world differs from the bare ground
where_texels_differ: ticks 0-3: the muzzle puff sits between the travel's dark copy (z -2) and its head (z 0) in the kit's canvas; two quads cannot interleave, so the puff lies under the whole travel
ticks 18-26: the drain streak (turned with the aim) and the burst (never turned) overlap, and their z-orders interleave in the kit
the last ticks: a footprint of 11-17 texels (embers going out), so one texel moves the mean
kit_quirk_matched: the kit's trail pool shows a newborn mote for one frame at the canvas origin (off the play frame); the port starts each mote a tick later, as seen
